opening.argument: The video explains a standard Uber referral promotion: viewers share an invite code, friends create an Uber account and book, and the participant receives a stated discount on a later ride. The spoken instructions make the reward process concrete, stating, “share your invite code share it with friends ask to create Uber account and book after that, get discount on next ride.” The Uber screen reinforces this ordinary promotion by presenting “Free trips,” an invite-code area, and WhatsApp sharing. Requests to subscribe, like, and share are ordinary audience engagement and are not presented as conditions for receiving the referral benefit.
